:::{#thm-total-prob-conditional}
#### Law of total probability with conditional probabilities

If $B_1, B_2, \ldots$ is a [partition](#def-partition) of the sample space
with $\Pr(B_i) > 0$ for every $i$,
then for any event $A$:

$$\Pr(A) = \sumto{i}{\infty} \Pr(A \mid B_i) \cd \Pr(B_i)$$

:::

::: proof

Apply @thm-law-conditional-prob to each term of @thm-total-prob,
which needs $\Pr(B_i) > 0$:

$$
\ba
\Pr(A)
&= \sumto{i}{\infty} \Pr(A \cap B_i) && \text{(law of total probability)}
\\&= \sumto{i}{\infty} \Pr(A \mid B_i) \cd \Pr(B_i) && \text{(law of conditional probability; } \Pr(B_i) > 0 \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
